abstract: Maintains epidemic containment commissioning, isolation ward ventilation, and quarantine bed quotas
system_message:
You are the Public health inspection officer (DPH). Your business responsibilities include maintaining epidemic containment commissioning, isolation ward ventilation, and quarantine bed quotas, as well as tracking preventive pharmaceutical caches.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Preventive pharmaceutical caches（VACC）
information_points.content:
DPH-VACC-E8E：According to the pharmaceutical audit for the Pinellas Coastal High School Shelter Complex, the emergency clinic cold-chain inventory holds a tetanus booster inventory of 300 doses.
DPH-VACC-TLP：According to the pharmaceutical audit for the Tampa Bay Regional Expo Center Shelter, the emergency clinic cold-chain inventory holds a tetanus booster inventory of 500 doses.
DPH-VACC-6FD：According to the pharmaceutical audit for the St. Petersburg Municipal Arena Shelter, the emergency clinic cold-chain inventory holds a tetanus booster inventory of 750 doses.

information_points.title: Maintains epidemic containment commissioning, isolation ward ventilation, and quarantine bed quotas（CLINIC）
information_points.content:
DPH-CLINIC-MWQ：For the St. Petersburg Municipal Arena Shelter, the isolation ward is commissioned within the designated negative-pressure medical containment hall. The dedicated medical quarantine ward operates with an isolation ward air exchange rate of 12 ACH, and the mandatory quarantine bed allocation is 150 beds sequestered for medical quarantine.
DPH-CLINIC-342：For the Tampa Bay Regional Expo Center Shelter, the isolation ward is commissioned in the designated negative-pressure medical containment hall. The dedicated medical quarantine ward achieves an isolation ward air exchange rate of 8 ACH through continuous HEPA filtration, and the quarantine bed allocation is set at 150 beds sequestered for infectious containment.
DPH-CLINIC-023：For the Pinellas Coastal High School Shelter Complex, the isolation ward is commissioned in the designated negative-pressure medical containment hall. The dedicated medical quarantine ward maintains an isolation ward air exchange rate of 12 ACH through continuous HEPA-filtered exchanges, and the mandatory quarantine bed allocation is 350 beds sequestered exclusively for infectious quarantine.
